title: cacalia floccosa
intro: Cacalia floccosa, commonly known as Yellow Corydalis or Fleece-flower, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of East Asia, belonging to the family Campanulaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-anxiety properties, as well as its ability to improve cognitive function and reduce stress. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and neuroprotective effects. Additionally, Cacalia floccosa has been found to possess antioxidant properties, which can help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage.
